title: Even graphs are edge-disjoint unions of cycles
abstract: Decomposes every finite loopless edge set with even degree at each vertex into edge-disjoint simple cycles and derives a simultaneous fixed-point-free pairing of incident edges.

informal.Finset.exists_cycleDecomp: Every finite loopless edge set whose degree is even at every vertex is the edge-disjoint union of simple cycles of length at least three.
informal.Finset.exists_edge_pairing_of_even: If every vertex has even degree, then the incident edges at every vertex admit a simultaneous fixed-point-free involutive pairing.
